name: UUIDv 4 Identifier
definition: Universally Unique IDentifier (UUID) version 4, as described in IETC RFC 4122 "Universally Unique IDentifier (UUID) URN Namespace".
format: Required format is 8 lowercase hexadecimal digits, then the character "-", then 4 lowercase hexadecimal digits, then the character "-", then the character "4", then 3 lowercase hexadecimal digits, then the character "-", then 1 any of 8 9 a b, then 3 lowercase hexadecimal digits, then the character "-", then 12 lowercase hexadecimal digits
